arxiv-2405-13557.title: MotionCraft : Physics-based Zero-Shot Video Generation
arxiv-2405-13557.creator: Luca Savant Aira, Antonio Montanaro, Emanuele Aiello, Diego Valsesia, Enrico Magli, Politecnico di Torino
arxiv-2405-13557.description: Abstract Generating videos with realistic and physically plausible motion is one of the main recent challenges in computer vision. While diffusion models are achieving compelling results in image generation, video diffusion models are limited by heavy training and huge models, resulting in videos that are still biased to the training dataset.

arxiv-2408-08552.title: Why Did Weyl Think that Emmy Noether Made Algebra the Eldorado of Axiomatics?
arxiv-2408-08552.creator: Iulian D. Toader
arxiv-2408-08552.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Iulian D. Toader. Abstract
: The paper attempts to clarify Weyl’s metaphorical description of Emmy Noether’s algebra as the Eldorado of axiomatics. It discusses Weyl’s early view on axiomatics, which is part of his criticism of Dedekind and Hilbert, as motivated by Weyl’s acquiescence to a phenomenological epistemology of correctness, then it describes Noether’s work in algebra, emphasizing in particular its ancestral relation to Dedekind’s and Hilbert’s works, as well as her mathematical methods, characterized by non-elementary reasoning, i.e., reasoning detached from mathematical objects.

arxiv-2411-06206.title: Text2CAD: Text to 3D CAD Generation via Technical Drawings
arxiv-2411-06206.creator: Mohsen Yavartanoo, Sangmin Hong, Reyhaneh Neshatavar, Kyoung Mu Lee
arxiv-2411-06206.description: Abstract The generation of industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from user requests and specifications is crucial to enhancing efficiency in modern manufacturing. Traditional methods of CAD generation rely heavily on manual inputs and struggle with complex or non-standard designs, making them less suited for dynamic industrial needs.

arxiv-2505-00664.title: A Key-Exchange Protocol Based on the Action of Circulant Matrices over Congruence-Simple Semirings
arxiv-2505-00664.creator: Álvaro Otero Sánchez
arxiv-2505-00664.description: Abstract We present a key-exchange protocol based on the action of circulant matrices over ℕ \mathbb{N} on tuples of pairwise commuting matrices over a congruence-simple semiring. The proposed exponentiation action replaces the polynomial action used in earlier semiring-based constructions and thereby avoids the linear structure exploited by the known polynomial attacks.

arxiv-2506-21015.title: HybridQ: Hybrid Classical-Quantum Generative Adversarial Network for Skin Disease Image Generation
arxiv-2506-21015.creator: Qingyue Jiao, Kangyu Zheng, Yiyu Shi, Zhiding Liang
arxiv-2506-21015.description: Abstract Machine learning-assisted diagnosis is gaining traction in skin disease detection, but training effective models requires large amounts of high-quality data. Skin disease datasets often suffer from class imbalance, privacy concerns, and object bias, making data augmentation essential. While classical generative models are widely used, they demand extensive computational resources and lengthy training time.

arxiv-2510-09135.title: Training Feature Attribution for Vision Models
arxiv-2510-09135.creator: Aziz Bacha & Thomas George
arxiv-2510-09135.description: Abstract Deep neural networks are often considered opaque systems, prompting the need for explainability methods to improve trust and accountability. Existing approaches typically attribute test-time predictions either to input features (e.g., pixels in an image) or to influential training examples. We argue that both perspectives should be studied jointly.

arxiv-2511-09996.title: A Novel Data-Dependent Learning Paradigm for Large Hypothesis Classes
arxiv-2511-09996.creator: Alireza F. Pour, Shai Ben-David
arxiv-2511-09996.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alireza F. Pour, Shai Ben-David. We address the general task of learning with a set of candidate models that is too large to have a uniform convergence of empirical estimates to true losses. While the common approach to such challenges is SRM (or regularization) based learning algorithms, we propose a novel learning paradigm that relies on stronger incorporation of empirical data and requires less algorithmic decisions to be based on prior assumptions.

Educated at Merchant Taylors' School and at St John’s College, Oxford, he took holy orders, being ordained priest on the 28th of May 1738.
